reviews.title: Life-changing habit tracker
reviews.text:
Everyday has been on my home screen since it first came out. I use it to track  essential healthcare compliance, and it keeps me very aware when I’ve missed a day. Super reliable, straightforward UI, at-a-glance summary of progress over a period of years. No gimmicky gamification; just the data you need to see. Outstanding response from developer. 

It’s the kind of app that has you saying, “This is the app I would’ve developed if I had been a genius.”

reviews.title: Simple and Easy
reviews.text: I’m really sick of apps with a million features and AI just to convolute things. Everyday does exactly what it says, the interface is simple and easy to navigate. It’s a visual habit tracker. I like the skip feature because I have chronic illnesses where I can’t always do everything. It’s really encouraging to know that one off day doesn’t kill your streak. Thanks for making a functional app with a great ethos.

reviews.title: Simple and effective!
reviews.text: All the other daily habit trackers had too many functions, too many pop ups, and too little customization. It’s not the flashiest, not the cutesiest, but it does its job very well!

reviews.title: Pretty perfect
reviews.text: After looking at so so so many tracking apps and being frustrated with the cost/function/simplicity of each one, I ended up with this one and could not be happier. If you want reminders, you can get reminders. If you want to schedule times for habits, that’s an option too. And it only gets better — there are small updates periodically that makes sense but don’t overwhelm. Totally worth the small cost for something I use every single day.
